provenance.description: 独自カタログ仕様に基づくAI生成。通常版とpixel版を別途生成。

expanded_prompts.sm-arcane-009-default-attempt001-prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one original creature portrait sprite for a 2D creature-raising game
Primary request: Create exactly one full-body creature following the complete independent brief below. This is a new design; do not base it on any existing character.
Management only, do not render text: sm-arcane-009 / カプネソラ / 魔体 (arcane)
Body and exact anatomy: 体幹2節の浅い半球を上下に合わせた形。脚6本、目4個、翼0枚、細長い尾1本。二半球の間に細い隙間
Materials and biological motif: 静かな拍子を作る光の皿。池のさざ波に合わせて水辺の音を重ねる
Primary, secondary, accent colors respectively: #88C3AE; #AC526F; #FCEDD0
Three mandatory visual identifiers: 上の半球は下の半球より広い; 四つの目は上皿の縁に等間隔; 尾は先端だけ小さな半円板
Pose: 皿をわずかに開き、六脚で水際に立つ
Temperament to convey through expression or posture: 協調的。雨音が強いと自分の音を弱める. If the brief specifies zero eyes or no face, do not invent eyes or facial features; express temperament through posture only.
Style: cohesive hand-drawn 2D fantasy game illustration, clear dark colored contour, restrained three-step cel shading, soft upper-left lighting, appealing natural creature proportions, clean readable form.
Composition: isolated single creature, full body; by default use a slight top-down three-quarter view facing toward image-right. If the individual pose explicitly requires a front or top view, that explicit pose takes priority. Preserve the specified pose and physical left/right features. Centered in a square canvas, no cropping. Keep transparent padding on all sides. Intended final canvas is 1024 by 1024 pixels, with the longest creature extent about 768–896 pixels and at least 64 pixels of clear padding.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no painted checkerboard, no backdrop, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no diffuse glow. Habitat, rocks, water surfaces and action scenery mentioned in the brief describe only body posture or temperament; do not render those objects or environments.
Constraints: preserve exact anatomy, all three identifiers and the position of the palette colors; no costume or held tool unless explicitly part of the brief.
Individual forbidden changes: 皿の隙間に歯を描かない; 半球を金属の食器にしない; 尾を複数に増やさない
Avoid: extra creatures, humans, text, letters, labels, logos, watermarks, decorative frame, gradients bleeding into the transparent area, photorealism, 3D render, imitation of an existing character.
expanded_prompts.sm-arcane-009-default-attempt002-prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Correct only the leg visibility/count and tail terminal shape of this original creature. It must have exactly six complete legs, three per physical side; arrange them so all six distinct legs and their separate endpoints are visible, not five and not seven. Keep the stance and proportions close to the reference, with no added arms. At the end of its single long slender tail replace the full oval disk with a small SEMICIRCULAR plate: one clearly straight diameter edge and one curved half-circle edge, not a full disk or ellipse. Keep both shallow hemispheres with upper wider than lower, narrow opening between them without teeth, exactly four eyes equally spaced around upper rim, mint primary #88C3AE, muted rose secondary #AC526F and cream accent #FCEDD0. Keep the same living light-plate material, right-facing three-quarter pose, clear dark contour and restrained cel shading. No metallic tableware, extra tail, scenery, ground, cast shadow, outside halo, text. One full body on genuine transparent alpha with ample margins. Change only these two identified failed anatomical conditions; preserve all unaffected features.
expanded_prompts.sm-arcane-009-default-attempt003-prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
The supplied creature still shows only FIVE separate leg tips. Correct this failed visibility condition: it must have exactly SIX complete legs, each with a clearly separate visible endpoint and gap to adjacent legs. Keep the five existing legs and reveal the sixth far-side rear leg in the open space below the body, without overlapping another leg tip. Count all six endpoints in the final artwork. Retain the two shallow body hemispheres, wider upper shell, narrow gap without teeth, exactly four equally spaced eyes on upper rim, single long tail and corrected small semicircular tail plate (one straight edge plus curved half-circle edge), same pose and proportions. Also correct only the rendering contract: organized dark colored outlines and restrained flat cel shading with at most three tone steps per material; simplify glossy caustic texture into a few calm cream-colored light shapes. Preserve mint #88C3AE primary, rose #AC526F secondary, cream #FCEDD0 accent. No plastic/glass/3D rendering or continuous gradients, no outside halo. No other redesign or added anatomy. Full single creature on genuine transparent alpha, square canvas with generous margins, no ground, scenery or text.
expanded_prompts.sm-arcane-009-pixel-attempt001-prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: one authentic pixel-art creature sprite, a paired rendition of the approved original illustration
Input image 1: the approved default illustration for sm-arcane-009; it is the identity reference and must remain the same creature.
Primary request: Redraw this exact creature as carefully constructed pixel art. Change only the rendering medium. Do not invent a replacement design and do not merely downsample or apply a pixelation filter to the input.
Management only, do not render text: sm-arcane-009 / カプネソラ / 魔体 (arcane)
Locked body and anatomy: 体幹2節の浅い半球を上下に合わせた形。脚6本、目4個、翼0枚、細長い尾1本。二半球の間に細い隙間
Locked material cues: 静かな拍子を作る光の皿。池のさざ波に合わせて水辺の音を重ねる
Locked palette roles, primary/secondary/accent: #88C3AE; #AC526F; #FCEDD0
All three identifiers must remain recognizable: 上の半球は下の半球より広い; 四つの目は上皿の縁に等間隔; 尾は先端だけ小さな半円板
Locked pose: 皿をわずかに開き、六脚で水際に立つ
Locked temperament/expression: 協調的。雨音が強いと自分の音を弱める. Preserve eyeless or faceless designs without adding eyes or a face; for those designs use posture to convey temperament.
Rendering: an intentional 128 by 128 logical pixel grid, readable pixel clusters, controlled staircase contours, consistent 1–2 logical pixel outline, limited palette no more than 32 visible colors, hard-edged opaque pixels and transparent background pixels only. Preserve exact counts of eyes, limbs, wings, tails and other declared structures. Simplify surface texture, never delete identity features or invent anatomy.
Composition: match the reference's facing, pose, relative color placement and body proportions. Full body, centered, longest creature extent about 96–112 logical pixels, at least 8 logical pixels of transparent padding on every side. No cropped body parts.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no drawn checkerboard, no backdrop, no shadow, no glow spilling out of the silhouette. Do not render any habitat, rock, water surface or action scenery mentioned in the brief; depict only the creature and its posture.
Individual forbidden changes: 皿の隙間に歯を描かない; 半球を金属の食器にしない; 尾を複数に増やさない
Avoid: antialiasing, blur, smooth gradients, semitransparent pixels, inconsistent pixel sizes, painterly miniatures, pixelation overlays, extra characters, text, letters, logos, watermarks, decorative frame, redesign.

processing_summary.default: alpha below8 cleared; isolated source alpha components under128 pixels cleared; alpha bbox cropped; proportional LANCZOS longest864; alpha below8 cleared; centered transparent1024; no shape redraw
processing_summary.pixel: independently generated pixel reference; alpha128 threshold; source isolated components under128 cleared; crop bbox; proportional nearest longest108; MEDIANCUT32 no dithering; binary alpha retained; centered128; no shape redraw

qa.basis: 通常原寸、pixel原寸と8倍nearest表示、通常/pixel比較を独立レビュー。六脚の個別可視化、四眼、上半球が広い二半球と細い隙間、半円尾先、pose・配色を確認。PNG規格・永続保存読戻しを検証。
review_notes: 通常初稿の五脚しか見えない状態・楕円尾先・過剰な光沢を画像生成編集で修正。原本保持。
pixelの小さい後方眼と細い後脚は簡略化されているが、原寸で識別可能。
